name: Do I need to get permits for exterior door replacement?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to get permits for exterior door replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most cases, replacing an existing exterior door with a new one of the same size and in the same location does not require a permit. However, if the project involves structural changes to the opening, such as widening the doorway or moving the door, a permit may be necessary. It is crucial to confirm local regulations, and Hometelligent Inc. can guide you on permit requirements based on your specific project and location within our service areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits are usually not needed for same-size, same-location replacements, but structural changes often require them. We can advise on local regulations.
